projects.title: Healthcare Navigator
description: Built a healthcare question-answering application centered on grounded responses, privacy safeguards, and human escalation. Answers require source citations; the system also redacts protected health information and supports handoff to a person when needed.

Requests are routed across model cost tiers to balance inference cost and answer quality. An evaluation suite checks response quality and provides a way to assess reliability as the application evolves.

projects.title: Audition With Me
description: An AI-powered rehearsal partner for actors. The application turns scripts into interactive scenes with voice-powered scene partners, so performers can practice their lines independently.

As a major product and engineering contributor, built guided rehearsal experiences with role selection, voice casting, live speech tracking, and teleprompter playback. Developed parsing for typed, scanned, bilingual, and annotated scripts; integrated contextual ElevenLabs voice delivery, caching, and persistent casting; and led a cinematic, responsive interface redesign.

projects.title: Podcast Search Engine
description: Built and deployed Podfind, a podcast search engine for nearly 800,000 episodes. Listeners can search in natural language and refine results by language, episode length, publication date, and explicit content.

The retrieval pipeline combines keyword and vector search, then reranks candidates for relevance. The interface shows how queries are interpreted, explains why episodes match, and supports episode playback and discovery of similar episodes.

projects.title: GEPA in DSpyNet
description: Implemented GEPA in DSpyNet, the open-source .NET port of Stanford's DSPy framework. The contribution adds feedback-driven prompt optimization to help language-model programs improve their instructions through evaluation rather than manual prompt editing alone.
The optimization process uses feedback from model outputs to generate and refine candidate prompts, extending the framework's tools for iterative LLM development.

experience.description: Building enterprise search and contract intelligence platforms from the ground up, including document parsing, structured extraction, citation verification, and human review workflows.

Built and deployed AI systems for mission-critical government and defense applications, including an LLM-based workforce classification platform and real-time radar/camera sensor fusion for drone tracking.
Built LLM extraction and translation services deployed on Kubernetes/OpenShift in secure government environments. Developed validated, monitored data pipelines to support ongoing model retraining.

Processed COVID-19 lab testing data for the CDC Emergency Operations Center and built data products used in briefings to CDC leadership and the White House Task Force. Co-led a 200+ member Spark community, developing reusable tools and training analytics practitioners.
